prose: Stratechery on the iPhone Duo: Apple once again demonstrated the power of integrating hardware and software, but its biggest AI blindspot might be its belief in the primacy of apps. The episode also covers the 'intelligent personal hub' idea and Apple Watch audio intelligence.
highlights: iPhone Duo shows Apple's hardware-software integration strength
Apple's biggest AI blindspot: belief in the primacy of apps
Also covered: the intelligent personal hub, Apple Watch audio intelligence
